title: COMP Pre-Xform Page
summary: Official Derivative common Pre-Xform page reference for applying an Object Component pre-transform to the left of the main Xform transform, with reset, commit, and matrix/CHOP/DAT transform options.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs a pre-transform that behaves like inserting a parent object before the main Xform page.
The Pre-Xform transform is applied to the left of the Xform page transform, so the matrix order is preXForm * xform * Position.
Use preset to clear the pre-transform and pcommit to bake the pre-transform into the main Xform page before resetting the Pre-Xform page.
Use xformmatrixop when the pre-transform should come from a 4x4 matrix supplied by a Matrix Parameters-compatible CHOP or DAT source.
